goldenUpdatePolicy.oraclePolicy: Kanvas-owned fixtures and reviewed dumps define pass/fail; external comparisons are drift-only.

dumpRows.updatePolicy: Producer dump changes require focused test diffs and matrix checkpoint updates before any golden promotion.
A8 mask golden changes require reviewed CPU coverage/hash diffs, refusal-diagnostic review, and explicit non-claim review without atlas, SDF, LCD, or GPU promotion.
A8/SDF lifecycle golden changes require fixture provenance, stable diagnostics, and matrix checkpoint updates without GPU upload or complete atlas lifecycle promotion.

Arabic GPOS trace golden changes require reviewed vendored mark-attachment evidence, reviewed generic gdef-required refusal evidence, deterministic runtime lookup facts, and explicit non-promotion of Arabic or complex-shaping support.

Arabic GSUB trace golden changes require reviewed vendored joining-form evidence, bounded lam-alef runtime-divergence review, deterministic runtime lookup facts, and explicit non-promotion of Arabic or complex-shaping support.
Arabic seed golden changes require diagnostic review and matrix checkpoint updates without Arabic or complex shaping support promotion.

Arabic shaped-glyph-run golden changes require reviewed vendored joining/mark rows, bounded lam-alef evidence, generic gdef-required refusal review, and explicit non-promotion of Arabic or complex-shaping support.
Arabic shaping-plan golden changes require reviewed script-policy defaults, refusal-on-missing expectations, and explicit non-promotion of Arabic or complex-shaping support.
Arabic shaping report updates require reviewed fixture/report diffs and explicit remaining-gate review without Arabic or complex-shaping support promotion.
Bidi runs golden changes require fixture text diff review, stable control/diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims without paragraph layout, shaping, or GPU text promotion.
Bitmap glyph plan golden changes require reviewed CBDT/CBLC and sbix case diffs, refusal diagnostic review, and explicit non-claim review without non-PNG or GPU route promotion.
CFF/CFF2 readiness golden changes require fixture provenance, explicit refusal coverage, and matrix checkpoint updates without Type 2 or CFF2 support promotion.
CFF Type 2 trace golden changes require deterministic generated-fixture traces, stable refusal diagnostics, and explicit non-claims without promoting real-font CFF support.
CFF INDEX/DICT golden changes require generated fixture provenance, stable parse diagnostics, explicit non-claims, and no host-font oracle expansion.
CFF scaler path-output golden changes require deterministic path-hash diffs, stable glyph-local diagnostics, explicit non-claims, and no real-font or GPU support promotion.

CFF subroutine trace golden changes require deterministic nested/local/global traces, fixed execution-limit serialization, stable refusal diagnostics, and explicit non-claims without promoting real-font CFF support.

CFF2 variation-trace golden changes require normalized-coordinate provenance, distinct path-hash evidence for default/min/max/named positions, stable refusal snapshots, and explicit non-claims without promoting full real-font or GPU support.

Cluster-safety golden changes require reviewed source-dump hash deltas, boundary-alignment reasoning, stable refusal diagnostics, and explicit confirmation that `scaledemoji` remains a gate rather than a support claim.
Format coverage changes require parser tests and explicit remaining-gate wording.

Color/emoji fixture-manifest changes require reviewed old/new manifest diffs, linked dump diffs, provenance review, legacy-gate mapping review, and explicit non-claims without COLRv1, bitmap, SVG, emoji, GPU, or platform fallback support promotion.

COLRv1 composite-plan dump changes require reviewed transform/composite/clip operation ordering, destination-read and layer-isolation fact review, clip-bound verification, refusal-diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims without recursion/cycle/bounds fixture promotion, bitmap, SVG, emoji, GPU execution, or platform fallback support promotion.

Color glyph plan bundle changes require reviewed COLRv0/COLRv1 case diffs, transform/composite/clip refusal review, bounds/artifact-key verification, and explicit non-claims without recursion/cycle/bounds fixture promotion, bitmap, SVG, emoji, GPU execution, or platform fallback support promotion.
Color/SVG/emoji golden changes require fixture provenance, refusal review, and matrix checkpoint updates without COLRv1, PNG, SVG, emoji, GPU, or platform fallback support promotion.

COLRv1 fixture-manifest changes require reviewed fixture provenance, expected dump linkage, cycle/recursion/budget diagnostic snapshot review, and explicit non-claims without COLRv1 operation support promotion, bitmap, SVG, emoji, GPU execution, or platform fallback support promotion.

COLRv1 paint-graph bundle changes require reviewed node-order, bounds propagation, transform classification, composite/clip refusal diffs, and explicit non-claims without recursion/cycle/bounds fixture promotion, bitmap, SVG, emoji, GPU execution, or platform fallback support.
Devanagari shaping report updates require reviewed runtime/fixture/report diffs and explicit remaining-gate review without Devanagari or Indic shaping support promotion.

DrawTextRun upload-plan dump changes require reviewed artifact key hash/order diffs, bounded leakage-audit field review, and explicit confirmation that no Sk type, font bytes, or live GPU handle leaked into the dump.

Emoji route trace golden changes require reviewed sequence-kind and text-range diffs, fallback-attempt review, route-diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims without full emoji shaping, platform emoji, GPU route, or scaledemoji support promotion.

Extension lookup report updates require reviewed checked-in synthetic fixture diffs, provenance index refresh, explicit remaining-gate review, and no promotion of chaining, reverse-chaining, GPOS advanced lookup, or variation/device support.
Facade inventory changes require reviewed route coverage, durable gate mapping, dashboard row wiring, and PM bundle diff review without facade support promotion.
Catalog dump changes require deterministic order tests and no host-path leakage.
Fallback trace golden changes require candidate-order, script/locale/emoji reason, refusal diagnostic, and matrix checkpoint review without fallback support promotion.
Per-fixture fallback golden changes require matching aggregate bundle review, stable refusal diagnostics, and no shaping or support promotion by implication.

Fallback segmentation golden changes require reviewed cluster-range diffs, dedicated per-fixture fallback-asset link review, explicit legacy-gate visibility, host-dependent marker review, and no fallback or emoji support promotion.

Fallback shaping golden changes require reviewed trace-link integrity, selected/rejected typeface facts, refusal diagnostics, and explicit confirmation that no cluster-safe or complete fallback support claim was introduced.
Feature policy matrix changes require script-row review, default-feature review, and non-claim review without shaping support promotion.
Bundled font catalog dump changes require deterministic-order review, duplicate/provenance diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims without promoting fallback, shaping, or platform-font parity.
Host-dependent catalog-link golden changes require deterministic-path ordering review and explicit confirmation that the linked rows remain non-normative and separate from the bundled catalog claim.
Scan-root golden changes require explicit fixture paths, stable accepted-family order, and matrix checkpoint updates.

Telemetry PM bundle evidence changes require stable tracked-gap classification, explicit advisory wording, bundle path review, and remaining-gate review without producer or release-gate claim expansion.
Telemetry schema dump changes require domain list, dimension policy, refusal diagnostic, and matrix checkpoint review without performance-gate promotion.
Telemetry fixture dump changes require repeated-run aggregation, GPU-dimension conditionality, refusal diagnostic, and matrix checkpoint review without budget or GPU-claim promotion.
Glyph artifact telemetry dump changes require reviewed route-count, bounded A8/SDF/COLR/bitmap/SVG cost evidence, stable refusal diagnostics, and explicit non-claims without GPU or dftext promotion.
Eviction-trace golden changes require reviewed generation/invalidation-token deltas, resident-byte diffs, and explicit non-claim review without GPU upload or dftext promotion.
Atlas golden changes require reviewed entry/source-hash/upload-byte diffs, generation-token review, and explicit non-claim review without GPU upload or dftext promotion.
Glyph atlas occupancy dump changes require reviewed artifact IDs, key hashes, dimensions, occupancy ratios, and explicit CPU-only non-claims without GPU upload or dftext promotion.

Glyph cache inventory golden changes require reviewed key-preimage/hash diffs, resident-byte accounting review, lifecycle-state review, and explicit non-claim review without GPU ownership or dftext promotion.
Glyph cache telemetry dump changes require reviewed pack-time, resident/upload-byte, hit/miss/eviction, invalidation-token, and refusal-diagnostic evidence without GPU or release-gate promotion.

Glyph cache telemetry golden changes require reviewed cold/warm sample deltas, advisory timing-counter diffs, budget-refusal review, and explicit confirmation that no blocking perf gate or GPU upload claim was introduced.
Strike-key golden changes require route-family, refusal, hash-preimage, and non-claim review before any artifact, atlas, or GPU route promotion.
Policy changes require spec 07 cross-reference review, cross-file consistency verification, and explicit non-claim preservation.
GPOS trace golden changes require reviewed simple and mark/cursive fixture provenance, parser refusal diagnostics, deterministic cluster-position facts, and no broader script promotion.
A8 route plan dump changes require reviewed atlas page/entry, binding-layout, non-claim, and bounded GPU-evidence diffs without broad GPU text or dftext promotion.
A8 refusal dump changes require reviewed missing-entry/stale-generation diagnostics that stay GPU-gated and must not broaden text GPU support or dftext-retirement claims.
GPU text binding plan changes require reviewed resource slots, reflected layout hash intent, atlas generation facts, and evidence that glyph/atlas/upload/live-handle facts stay outside MaterialKey.

GPU handoff telemetry dump changes require reviewed route outcome diffs, stable text.gpu/unsupported.text diagnostics, advisory-only wording, and explicit confirmation that no GPU support claim or dftext retirement was added.
GPU text instance layout changes require reviewed stride, alignment, attributes, glyph target/source/UV facts, page/generation facts, representation flags, and instance-upload-before-draw dependency.

GPU text ordering trace changes require reviewed upload-before-sample, instance-upload-before-draw, generation validation, draw-before-eviction barrier, refusal diagnostic, and non-claim diffs without executed upload, broad GPU text support, general scheduler, or dftext retirement claims.

GPU text resource plan changes require reviewed ownership, atlas descriptor/page/entry refs, lifetime scope, refusal diagnostics, and explicit confirmation that no GPU handles, broad text support, executed upload, or dftext retirement claim was added.

GPU text resource refusal changes require stable text.gpu/unsupported.text diagnostics for missing upload, upload budget overflow, unavailable page, missing entry, and binding layout unavailable cases.

GPU text subrun plan dump changes require reviewed split reason, source glyph range, ordering token, refusal diagnostic, and non-claim diffs without broad GPU text, executed upload, or dftext promotion.
GPU text upload plan changes require reviewed destination texture plan, byte range, row stride, staging, upload-before-sample dependency, and explicit non-execution wording.
GSUB trace golden changes require reviewed Latin simple/contextual fixture provenance, parser refusal diagnostics, deterministic nested-lookup and cycle-guard facts, and no broader script promotion.

Hit-test dump changes require reviewed caret affinity, placeholder ID routing, out-of-bounds clamp behavior, and explicit non-claims without bidi visual ordering, word-boundary completeness, ellipsis, or GPU text promotion.
Latin GSUB/GPOS golden changes require fixture provenance, feature-order and cluster review, and matrix checkpoint updates without broader script promotion.

Line-break dump changes require reviewed break-opportunity diffs, locale-refinement diagnostic review, deterministic inputHash review, and explicit non-claim preservation without complete UAX #14 or paragraph support promotion.

targetSpec.section: Font sources, SFNT/OpenType parsing, and collections

dumpRows.updatePolicy: Malformed SFNT fixture-suite changes require deterministic byte hashes, one primary expected diagnostic per case, explicit linked evidence, and non-claim review.
OpenType layout contract GPOS trace changes require contract review and stable diagnostic review without GPOS lookup implementation or support promotion.
OpenType layout contract GSUB trace changes require contract review and stable diagnostic review without GSUB lookup implementation or support promotion.
OpenType layout contract shaped-glyph-run changes require contract review without support promotion.
Paragraph input dump changes require deterministic inputHash review, range/diagnostic review, and explicit non-claim preservation without promoting downstream paragraph support.
Paragraph input golden changes require style-range, placeholder, diagnostic, and downstream shaping/fallback blocker review without complete paragraph support promotion.

Paragraph layout golden changes require reviewed line-local truncation facts, ellipsis provenance diffs, mixed-style and RTL-direction case review, stable refusal-diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims without complete bidi visual ordering or GPU text promotion.

Paragraph layout dump changes require reviewed segment references, placeholder-box geometry review, merged shaping/fallback diagnostics, and explicit non-claims without bidi visual ordering, hit testing, or GPU text promotion.
Paragraph telemetry dump changes require reviewed line-break, hit-test, selection, placeholder, and refusal-diagnostic diffs without paragraph parity, GPU text, or performance-gate promotion.

Paragraph shaping request dump changes require reviewed style/script/bidi/fallback segmentation diffs, placeholder exclusion review, and explicit non-claims without line breaking, hit testing, or GPU text promotion.
Paragraph shaping request golden changes require mixed-script, variation-axis, fallback, placeholder, and cluster-boundary case review without complete paragraph support promotion.
Parser telemetry dump changes require reviewed fixture IDs, stable advisory trend series, semantic malformed-table diagnostics, and matrix checkpoint updates without performance-gate promotion.
Placeholder layout dump changes require baseline/alignment geometry review, deterministic inputHash review, and explicit non-claims without selection, hit-testing, ellipsis, or GPU text promotion.
PNG dump changes require malformed payload refusals and stable pixel hash tests.
Resolved fallback run golden changes require cluster-range, selected typeface, fallback-reason, refusal diagnostic, and matrix checkpoint review without shaping or fallback support promotion.
Scaler telemetry dump changes require reviewed fixture IDs, stable advisory trend series, malformed/refusal diagnostics, and matrix checkpoint updates without performance-gate promotion.
Script run golden changes require fixture text diff review, pinned Unicode source review, stable diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims without GSUB/GPOS, paragraph, or GPU text promotion.
SDF dump changes require distance-range and sample-bound tests.

SDF artifact golden changes require reviewed spread/padding/hash diffs, normalization-edge checks, refusal-diagnostic review, and explicit non-claim review without atlas, GPU, LCD, or dftext promotion.
Format 14 readiness golden changes require required-table checks, diagnostic review, and explicit remaining-gate wording.
SFNT table fact dump changes require deterministic table-order tests, missing-required and malformed-optional diagnostics, and matrix checkpoint updates without parser payload or support promotion.

Shaped glyph run golden changes require reviewed Latin GSUB simple/contextual, simple GPOS, and bounded mark/cursive fixture provenance, cluster-range review, deterministic advance/offset facts, and bounded cycle/refusal diagnostics without broader shaping promotion.

Shaping telemetry dump changes require reviewed segmentation, bidi, script-itemization, fallback, emoji-refusal, and script-fixture diffs without script-support, GPU text, or performance-gate promotion.
Shaping plan golden changes require schema, required case coverage, and diagnostic review without feature, fallback, paragraph, or GPU text support promotion.
SVG dump changes require bounded parser and refusal tests.
SVG fixture manifest golden changes require reviewed bounds-hash diffs, refusal-class review, provenance review, and explicit non-claim review without dynamic SVG or GPU route promotion.
SVG glyph plan golden changes require reviewed primitive-summary diffs, budget/refusal review, and explicit non-claim review without dynamic SVG or GPU route promotion.
Host-dependent scan golden changes require deterministic-path ordering review, stable diagnostic review, and explicit confirmation that the bounded fixture directory remains non-normative.
MaterialKey leakage golden changes require variance-fixture expansion or new negative-fixture categories with explicit review of each excluded field and non-promotional diagnostics.

Text WGSL reflection dump changes require reviewed module hash, entry point, binding, uniform layout, instance input, wgsl4k SHA, and non-claim diffs without route promotion or broad GPU text support.
Text WGSL validation report changes require reviewed Kotlin plan comparisons, reflected binding refs, refusal diagnostics, SDF parameter policy, route-promotion policy, and non-claim diffs.
Thai/CJK boundary report updates require reviewed runtime/fixture/report diffs and explicit remaining-gate review without Thai or CJK shaping support promotion.
TrueType composite glyph golden changes require point-matching, transform, recursion, invalid component, component-count, metrics, and non-claim review before any claim promotion.

TrueType gvar IUP golden changes require simple-contour explicit/inferred delta review, wraparound verification, contour-isolation coverage, avar normalization evidence, composite child evidence, phantom-point advance review, bounded HVAR advance-width review, bounded MVAR vertical-global metric review, malformed HVAR/MVAR and tuple diagnostics, and non-claim review before any claim promotion.
Malformed glyf isolation golden changes require face-versus-glyph refusal review, safe-glyph positive-control review, stable diagnostic review, and explicit non-claims before any claim promotion.
TrueType variation readiness golden changes require variation fixture provenance, diagnostic review, and explicit remaining-gate wording before any variable-font support promotion.

TrueType vertical metric golden changes require vhea/vmtx parsing review, fallback diagnostic review, bounded VVAR advance-height review, malformed-table diagnostic review, and non-claim review before any claim promotion.
Unicode data manifest golden changes require input SHA-256 review, generated table hash diffs, and explicit non-claim review without replacing BasicUnicodeData.
Unicode seed dump changes require bounded source extract diffs, generated table hash review, and explicit non-claim review without Unicode conformance or shaping promotion.
Unicode version mismatch diagnostic changes require stable reason-code review and must not imply segmentation, bidi, shaping, or GPU text support.

Unicode segments golden changes require bounded Unicode source extract diff review, per-boundary rule review, deterministic diagnostics, and explicit non-claims without shaping, paragraph, or GPU text promotion.
